review_description: Do you homework!  Don't rely on the sales person to give you the information you need, particularly if you need specific technical answers.Most sales people don't have a technical background so you might not get the right information.

Mark Group Australia was the only one of the three suppliers that you provided details for which actually followed through with an on-site quote. I chose the size, type of panels and brand of inverter that I wanted for the system and the price they quoted for the exact same system was virtually identical to that which I ultimately accepted from FROG Solutions.
Very professional service, Frog employ all their own staff permanently. Work done in a courteous manor, even when one man got sick., and then it rained.
